name: HYDRA-UMC-DEV-SERVER
technologies: SQLite (durable task/state journal, from DS05 onward)
build: Ten-delivery plan (DS01-DS10, see this repository's own README Roadmap section): a reproducible development host (target platform: Raspberry Pi 5 or Compute Module 5, both 8GB, NVMe-booted) that hosts this ecosystem's source code, an isolated task/workspace runner for bounded programming/build/test work, and a durable queue coordinating with HYDRA-UMC-OPS-AGENT's own incident lifecycle - never a new AI to train, never a replacement operating system, never itself the authority that decides a machine is safe. Real build: python -m build (see pyproject.toml).
deployment_target_note: "dev-server" is a new deployment_target value, not yet used elsewhere in this ecosystem's manifests (existing values: cm5, mobile, user-pc, wearable). It denotes a Raspberry Pi 5 / CM5 host dedicated to development and task execution - explicitly NOT the same physical role as "cm5" (the operational node that talks to real machines/robots). Documented here so HYDRA-UMC-UPDATER/the dashboard do not misread it as an operational CM5.
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.3 - DS01 + DS02 + DS03 of the 10-delivery plan (contracts, limits and a verifiable skeleton). Every delivery so far only reads and describes; nothing copies, provisions, executes or deploys. DS01: state-ownership table (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), the 17-relationship grouping (docs/OPS_INTEGRATION.md), and a real, tested configuration schema (configs/*.example.json + config.py) whose default policy grants NO task deployment permission - verified by test. inventory.py discovers/validates this ecosystem's own hydra-umc.project.json manifests. DS02: a validated remote-station profile (remote_station.py - routable bind address refused unless allow_public_bind is the literal true; identity is a dedicated system account, never root/login user), a read-only host preflight (preflight.py - injectable HostInspector seam) and a dry-run provisioning plan (provision.py - argv as data, refused over a failed preflight, never executed). DS03: conservative migration (migration.py) - hashes and classifies every file in a source checkout (tracked-clean / tracked-modified / untracked / private via a widenable PrivacyPolicy), records unpushed commits, and renders a plan sending each class to its own of four provably-separate destinations, refusing if a private file would land under a shareable root; SourceInspector seam keeps every test off a real disk. CLI: config / inventory / station / migrate subcommands. No workspace runner, task queue, AI provider integration or OPS-AGENT wiring exists yet: those are DS04, DS05, DS06 and DS07 respectively, each a separate future delivery.
